name: tagpilot-gtm-mcp
description: Free, read-only Google Tag Manager: containers, tags, triggers and variables, workspace diffs against the live version, references and container audits. No Google Cloud setup.
long_description:
Ask Claude about your Google Tag Manager containers: what tags fire on which triggers, how a variable or trigger is set up and what uses it, what publishing a workspace would change compared with the live version, the version history, and a Tag Pilot audit (tags that never fire, unused triggers and variables, tags without consent settings, duplicate Google tag IDs, unpublished changes).

**No Google Cloud setup.** Install, ask a GTM question, and approve in the browser window that opens: sign in to (or create) your free Tag Pilot account, confirm the code, and allow read-only Tag Manager access. No API key to copy.

**Read-only and private.** The only Google scope is `tagmanager.readonly`: nothing can be created, changed, published or deleted. Your container data goes from your computer straight to Google; Tag Pilot only brokers the token exchange and stores no Google tokens. The refresh token stays on your computer in `~/.config/tagpilot/gtm-mcp`.
